facts.subject: Tolan imports
facts.statement: Tolan depends on imported rice, wheat and fuel for most of its needs.

source_ref.text_snippet: It produces few goods of its own and depends on imported rice, wheat and fuel for most of its needs.

facts.subject: Tolan imports
facts.statement: The main imports are rice, wheat and fuel.

source_ref.text_snippet: The main imports are rice, wheat and fuel.

facts.subject: Tolan exports
facts.statement: The country's exports are limited and consist mainly of services and small quantities of light manufactures.

source_ref.text_snippet: The country's exports are limited and consist mainly of services and small quantities of light manufactures.

facts.subject: Tolan Harbour
facts.statement: Tolan Harbour is the principal island port, handling containers, bulk cargo and passenger traffic.

source_ref.text_snippet: Tolan Harbour is the principal island port, handling containers, bulk cargo and passenger traffic.

facts.subject: Tolan road network
facts.statement: The island has a single main road network and relies on coastal shipping and a small number of scheduled services for connections to the mainland.

source_ref.text_snippet: The island has a single main road network and relies on coastal shipping and a small number of scheduled services for connections to the mainland.

facts.subject: Tolan main road
facts.statement: The main road runs around the coast, with smaller routes into the hills.

source_ref.text_snippet: The main road runs around the coast, with smaller routes into the hills.

facts.subject: Scheduled passenger service
facts.statement: A scheduled passenger service connects the harbour to the mainland, and most goods arrive by sea.

source_ref.text_snippet: A scheduled passenger service connects the harbour to the mainland, and most goods arrive by sea.
